rules.cpu_curve: CPU level = 1 + round(3 * p), where p = wave index / (waves - 1): Easy (1) on wave 1, Very Hard (4) on the last wave, never Very Easy (0). Levels are the mod's story difficulty 0-4.
rules.buff_rule: From the halfway point (p >= 0.5) every enemy is buffed with Potara: waves of 3-5 get 3 slots of boosts, pairs 5, solo enemies the full 7 (more in the last quarter: +30,000 health), and the final wave the boss loadout. Before halfway nobody is buffed unless you mark them.

tiers.group: waves of 3-5: Attack/Defense/Ki Power Up 1 (3 slots)
tiers.pair: waves of 2: Attack Up 2 + Defense Up 2 + Super Up 1 (5 slots)
tiers.solo: alone in a wave: Attack Up 3 + Defense Up 2 + Ki Power Up 1 + Super Up 1 (7 slots)
tiers.solo_late: alone in the last quarter: +30,000 max health item (Strength Enhancement on BT3, Whis Training on BT4) + Attack/Defense Up (7 slots)
tiers.boss: final wave: Attack Up 3 + Defense Up + the +30,000 health item (7 slots)

rules.wave_break: 15 s break between waves (the game's countdown timer); a KO'd enemy disappears after 5 s.

sources.roster: kit_catalog.build() run on each ISO (names, forms, costume counts, portraits)
sources.potara: kit_potara.inventory() (stats, slot cost, category) + item descriptions from UI text part 34 on each disc

gauntlets.title: Quick Test
gauntlets.description: Three short waves to try the mode: Cui, then Dodoria and Zarbon, then Frieza.
gauntlets.description_es: Tres oleadas cortas para probar el modo: Cui, luego Dodoria y Zarbon, y al final Frieza.

gauntlets.title: Android & Cell Saga
gauntlets.description: Mecha Frieza to Super Saiyan 2 Gohan.
gauntlets.description_es: De Mecha Frieza a Gohan Super Saiyan 2.

waves.label: Goku at the Cell Games
waves.label_es: Goku en los Juegos de Cell

gauntlets.notes: Goku at the Cell Games wears the gi without the kanji. The final boss follows your Namek pattern: the hero who wins the saga. BT4: "Cell - Perfect" (id 107) is Perfect Cell and "Cell - Perfect Form" (id 224) is the Super Perfect Cell portrait.

gauntlets.title: Androids & Red Ribbon
gauntlets.description: The Red Ribbon Army's creations, from General Blue to Super 17.
gauntlets.description_es: Las creaciones de la Patrulla Roja, del General Blue a Super 17.
gauntlets.notes: Super 17 is last (GT, the final Red Ribbon android).

gauntlets.title: Majin Buu Saga
gauntlets.description: From the World Tournament to Kid Buu.
gauntlets.description_es: Del Torneo de Artes Marciales a Kid Buu.
gauntlets.notes: Videl in her short-hair tournament costume. Kid Buu is kept last (canon end); Super Buu with Gohan absorbed is the strongest Buu, so it sits two waves earlier with solo boosts.

gauntlets.title: Earthlings
gauntlets.description: Every human of Earth, in order of first appearance.
gauntlets.description_es: Todos los humanos de la Tierra, por orden de aparición.

waves.label: Red Ribbon & Crane School
waves.label_es: La Patrulla Roja y la Escuela de la Grulla

waves.label: Korin Tower & the bride
waves.label_es: La torre de Karin y la novia

gauntlets.notes: Restored to the first draft (humans in order of first appearance), with Krillin moved to the end as the strongest earthling: his end-of-Z costume (hair, costume 4) with the final-boss Potara. Krillin has no transformations on the disc, so the costume and loadout carry the "strongest" role. Androids 17/18 and Dr. Gero count as human-based; Arale and Android 8 do not.

gauntlets.title: Every Fighter
gauntlets.description: All 161 selectable entries (every form counts), ordered by power: comic and weak fighters in crowds first, gods and the strongest forms alone at the end.
gauntlets.description_es: Las 161 entradas seleccionables (cada forma cuenta), por orden de poder: primero los cómicos y débiles en grupo, al final los dioses y las formas más fuertes en solitario.
gauntlets.notes: Round 2: reordered by a hand-set power score (0-106) instead of roster ID. Early waves are crowds of 5, then 4s, 3s and pairs; the top 6 fight alone. Band names in the wave labels show where you are on the curve. Everyone uses costume 1. Includes Future Gohan Super Saiyan (ID 160).

gauntlets.title: Frieza Clan & Frieza Force
gauntlets.description: Frieza's soldiers, the Ginyu Force, every Frieza form and his family.
gauntlets.description_es: Los soldados de Frieza, las Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu, cada forma de Frieza y su familia.
gauntlets.notes: Dramatic reorder: Cooler's final form (his brother) is the last boss, after the Meta-Coolers.

gauntlets.title: Fusions & Absorptions
gauntlets.description: Every fusion on the disc (plus Buu's absorptions and Super 17).
gauntlets.description_es: Todas las fusiones del disco (más las absorciones de Buu y Super 17).
gauntlets.notes: Absorptions (Super Buu) and Super 17 count as fusions here. Pilaf Machine - Fusion is placed with GT (its robots combine at GT's start).

gauntlets.title: Great Apes
gauntlets.description: Every Great Ape on the disc. At most two at a time.
gauntlets.description_es: Todos los Ozaru (monos gigantes) del disco. Como mucho dos a la vez.
gauntlets.notes: Two Great Apes per wave at most (arena space). Great Ape Baby, the golden ape, is the last boss.

gauntlets.title: Dragon Ball GT
gauntlets.description: Baby, Super 17 and the Shadow Dragons, ending on Gogeta SS4.
gauntlets.description_es: Baby, Super 17 y los Dragones Oscuros, hasta Gogeta SS4.
gauntlets.notes: Kept Gogeta SS4 as the last boss (strongest GT form). BT3 lacks Trunks/Goten/Vegeta (GT) base, Eis Shenron and the other Shadow Dragons.

gauntlets.title: Majin
gauntlets.description: Babidi's Majin army and every Buu.
gauntlets.description_es: El ejército Majin de Babidi y todos los Buu.
gauntlets.notes: All solo waves (each Buu is one being). Kid Buu, the original form, is the last boss.

gauntlets.title: DBZ Movie Villains
gauntlets.description: Every Dragon Ball Z film villain, in release order.
gauntlets.description_es: Todos los villanos de las películas de Dragon Ball Z, por orden de estreno.
gauntlets.notes: Release order (Garlic Jr. 1989 to Hirudegarn 1995). Dramatic reorder: Super Janemba is last as the strongest film villain. Meta-Coolers come as a trio, as in the film.

gauntlets.title: Namek Saga
gauntlets.description: Cui to Super Saiyan Goku, following your outline wave for wave.
gauntlets.description_es: De Cui a Goku Super Saiyan, oleada a oleada como en la saga.
gauntlets.notes: Your outline, kept exactly. Costumes: Gohan/Krillin in their own clothes early (wave 3), in Namekian battle armor from wave 7; Vegeta in the new Frieza-force armor (no shoulder pads); base Goku in the Namek gi; Super Saiyan Goku in the torn gi. Wave 4 Vegeta is "buffed a little" (Attack/Defense Up 1) as you asked, even though it is before the halfway point.

gauntlets.title: Original Dragon Ball
gauntlets.description: Pilaf to Piccolo Jr.: every original Dragon Ball fighter on the disc.
gauntlets.description_es: De Pilaf a Piccolo Jr.: todos los luchadores del Dragon Ball original del disco.

waves.label: Fortuneteller Baba's fighters
waves.label_es: Los luchadores de Baba la Adivina

gauntlets.notes: Yamcha in his bandit outfit, Roshi as Jackie Chun, Kid Goku in the orange turtle gi at Korin Tower. Devilman is Fortuneteller Baba's fighter.

gauntlets.title: Saiyan Saga
gauntlets.description: Raditz to Great Ape Vegeta: the Saiyans invade Earth.
gauntlets.description_es: De Raditz a Vegeta Ozaru: los Saiyans invaden la Tierra.
gauntlets.notes: Dramatic reorder: Gohan's Great Ape (wave 10) is placed before Great Ape Vegeta so the Saiyan Prince is the final boss. Saibamen use different costumes (colour variants) for variety.

gauntlets.title: Saiyans
gauntlets.description: Every Saiyan warrior in order of first appearance, one canonical form each.
gauntlets.description_es: Todos los guerreros Saiyan por orden de aparición, una forma canónica de cada uno.
gauntlets.notes: Includes Saiyan fusions (Gotenks, Vegito, Gogeta). Great Apes have their own gauntlet. Kept Gogeta SS4 last as the strongest Saiyan on BT3. Round 2 (your review): Future Gohan and Trunks are Super Saiyans; Goten and Kid Trunks are Super Saiyans; a Goku Super Saiyan 3 wave sits between Majin Vegeta and Gotenks SS3; Gogeta (Fusion Reborn) now comes before Super Vegito. Future Gohan Super Saiyan (ID 160) is not on the native select grid; its files pass the compatibility scan.

gauntlets.title: Villains
gauntlets.description: Every era's villains in chronological order, in mixed groups.
gauntlets.description_es: Los villanos de cada época en orden cronológico, en grupos mixtos.

waves.label: Red Ribbon revenge
waves.label_es: La venganza de la Patrulla Roja

gauntlets.notes: Grouped by era so each wave is a squad. Omega Shenron is the last boss.

gauntlets.title: World Martial Arts Tournament
gauntlets.description: Every tournament entrant, from the 21st Tournament to Goku vs Uub at the 28th.
gauntlets.description_es: Todos los participantes del torneo, del 21.º Torneo al Goku contra Uub del 28.º.

waves.label: Cell Games champion
waves.label_es: Campeón de los Juegos de Cell

gauntlets.notes: Roshi is Jackie Chun, Yamcha has his long hair. The last boss is Goku at the 28th tournament (his final fight in Z).

gauntlets.title: Z Fighters
gauntlets.description: Earth's defenders from the Saiyan arrival to the end of Z.
gauntlets.description_es: Los defensores de la Tierra, de la llegada de los Saiyans al final de Z.

waves.label: Hyperbolic Time Chamber
waves.label_es: La Habitación del Espíritu y el Tiempo

gauntlets.notes: Dramatic reorder: Super Vegito (strongest) is last; canonically Vegito came before the Kid Buu fight.
